Scenario: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow at 400% zoom (320px CSS viewport width)
Steps:
1. Set viewport to 320x800 (equivalent to 1280px display at 400% browser zoom).
2. Assert no two-dimensional scrolling (scrollWidth <= innerWidth).
Expected Result: Content reflows into a single column without requiring horizontal scrolling (WCAG 1.4.10).
Actual Result: FAILED: Requires 2D scrolling. scrollWidth (421px) exceeds viewport width (320px) by 101px.

Scenario: WCAG 1.4.10 Reflow at 200% zoom (640px CSS viewport width)
Steps:

2. Assert no horizontal scrolling.
Expected Result: Page content reflows into single/two-column layout without clipping or horizontal overflow.
Actual Result: PASSED: Clean reflow at 640px width.
